summary: AUDIT of the sauna cost-price chain (components -> tech-cards -> totalCost -> sauna_prices.costPrice -> order margin) + warehouse/stock module. Wrote 27 pytest cases (/app/backend/tests/test_techcards_audit_iteration121.py) against the public URL as admin: 24 passed, 3 failed (all 3 are real product bugs/gaps, not test issues). Core arithmetic and the critical sync linkage are CORRECT: materialsCost = sum(unitPrice*qty), overhead = materials*pct/100, totalCost = materials+labor+overhead+manual, retailNetto = round(brutto/1.23), marginAmount = netto-total, marginPct, retailMarginAmount = margin-retailExtraCost — all verified numerically; syncToCostPrice writes totalCost + retailExtraCost into sauna_prices (model scope verified), component unitPrice change auto-recomputes affected cards AND re-syncs costPrice, recompute-all works, deleted-component 'missing' flag works, component DELETE blocked (400) while used. Order margin linkage VERIFIED end-to-end: created a sauna order, ran POST /api/sauna/orders/recompute-margins, order.totalCost == synced costPrice and order.margin == round(total/1.23 - costPrice - retailExtraCost). Warehouse: stock-adjust in/out/set + validation + movements log OK; production-stock preview/deduct/revert verified (deduct -3 / -2.5, repeat deduct correctly 409, revert restores exact original stock, double revert 409). Dashboard OK. Frontend smoke (admin, 1920x1080): production page, Тех.карты, Комплектующие (71 rows), Закупка (both sub-tabs), tech-card editor live math (labor 1234 -> Себестоимость 1 234 zł, netto 21 764, margin 20 530 / 94.3% — matches backend formula), stock dialog with history — all render with ZERO console errors. All QA data cleaned up; target model costPrice/retailExtraCost restored to original (8000 / 0).

critical.issue: Returns 500 'E11000 duplicate key error ... index: amocrm_id_1 dup key: { amocrm_id: null }'. CRMLead always serialises amocrm_id=None, and the index created in server.py:447 is unique+SPARSE (sparse only skips MISSING fields, not explicit nulls) — so only ONE manually created lead (without amoCRM id) can ever exist in the DB. Manual lead creation from the CRM UI is broken. Fix: use a partialFilterExpression ({amocrm_id: {$type: 'string'}}) or omit the field (exclude_none) when it is None.

minor.issue: For a lead with no resolvable model/tech-card the endpoint claims the productionStockDeducted flag BEFORE aggregating the BOM and returns 200 with applied=0. The lead is then permanently marked as deducted — the later real deduction (after the model is set) is rejected with 409. Should not set the flag when applied==0 (or should return a warning).

Response rows contain only componentId/name/category/unit/unitPrice/totalQty/lineTotal/sources — NO stockCurrent / stockMin / shortage. The requested 'required vs current stock (shortages)' capability does not exist in the backend, and ProcurementForecast.jsx does not compute it client-side either. Purchasing cannot see deficits.

Leads in production whose model cannot be resolved produce ZERO targets, so they are counted neither in matchedTargets nor in unmatched. UI therefore shows 'Не найдено тех.карт: 0' and 0 positions for 2 active orders — silently misleading (verified in the Закупка tab screenshot).
Non-atomic read-then-$set (concurrent adjustments can be lost; deduct uses $inc correctly) and 'out' may drive stockCurrent negative with no warning/guard.
Returns only {ok, affectedCards, priceChanged} — not the updated component; clients must refetch. Also no validation that unitPrice >= 0.

issues: 60 of 71 components have Остаток 0 and Мин. 0, so the stock column carries no signal and no low-stock highlighting is visible — data readiness issue for the warehouse module (informational).
Shows '0 позиций' / '0 zł' with model column '—' for 2 in-production orders without any hint that the leads have no linked model/tech-card (see backend issue above).

action_items: CRITICAL: fix the sauna_crm_leads amocrm_id unique index (partialFilterExpression on string type) or stop persisting amocrm_id=null — manual lead creation currently 500s.
Do not set productionStockDeducted when the BOM aggregation yields applied==0 (currently blocks the real deduction forever with 409).
Add stockCurrent/stockMin + shortage (required - stock) to /procurement/forecast and /procurement responses and surface deficits in ProcurementForecast.jsx.
Count leads with no resolvable model as 'unmatched' in /procurement so the UI can warn instead of silently showing 0 positions.

Data readiness for the owner: the DB currently contains 0 tech-cards, while only 2/13 models and 1/12 variants have costPrice>0 (values came from Excel/manual, not from tech-cards). Margins shown in orders/dashboard are therefore mostly based on empty or non-BOM-backed cost prices.
critical_code_review_comments: VAT 0.23 is hardcoded in three places (sauna_tech_cards._compute_totals, sauna_orders.VAT_RATE, TechCardEditor.jsx) — extract to one shared config value to avoid divergence.
routes/sauna_tech_cards.py is 1156 lines with two stacked module docstrings — split into components/tech-cards/stock/procurement/export modules (>700-line rule).

Two different margin definitions coexist: tech-card marginAmount/dashboard avgMarginPct EXCLUDE retailExtraCost while order margin SUBTRACTS it. Label them explicitly (dealer vs retail) in the dashboard, otherwise the owner compares incomparable numbers.
_compute_totals returns margin=0 when retailNetto==0, masking a real negative margin for entities without a retail price; prefer None.
_sync_cost_price_to_sauna_prices always $sets models+categories+options; if the prices doc lacks 'options'/'categories' they get created as [] — harmless today but a silent schema mutation.
For scope='option' the retail baseline is o.price only; open-price / per-m2 options will produce a meaningless margin (no guard or flag).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all audited views render, live math correct, no console errors)

seed_data_creation: Temporary only: 2 QA-COMP-* components, 1 model-scope + 1 variant-scope tech card on sauna_kwadro_beczka_235x200_cm, 2 QA leads, 1 QA sauna order, QA stock movements. ALL deleted; sauna_prices costPrice/retailExtraCost for the target model restored to the original 8000/0 (verified in Mongo after the run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Endpoints live under /api/sauna-production/cost/* (NOT /api/sauna-tech-cards/*). Order margin recompute is POST /api/sauna/orders/recompute-margins (GET /api/sauna/orders returns a plain array). CRM lead creation via API is broken (amocrm_id null dup key) — the audit test inserts test leads directly via pymongo as a workaround; remove that workaround once the index is fixed. Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_techcards_audit_iteration121.py -p no:xdist. Expected after fixes: 27/27.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) sauna_crm_leads index: server.py creates create_index('amocrm_id', unique=True, sparse=True); sparse excludes only documents MISSING the key, but the CRMLead pydantic model always emits amocrm_id=None, so every manual lead is indexed with value null → the second one violates uniqueness → 500. 2) production-stock deduct: manual_deduct_production_stock claims the idempotency flag with a conditional update BEFORE calling deduct_production_stock, so an empty BOM (no targets extracted from the lead) still marks the lead deducted. 3) procurement forecast: _aggregate_targets never reads sauna_components.stockCurrent into its output rows, so no shortage math exists anywhere in the chain.
